domains_aggregated.1_farm_identity_and_location: name, division, district, upazila, village, total_area, area_unit, soil_type, coordinates
domains_aggregated.2_registered_crops_and_statuses: crop list, current stages, sowing/transplanting/harvest dates, status
domains_aggregated.3_soil_test_and_nutrient_completeness: latest lab vs farmer soil tests, pH, NPK, organic matter, micronutrients, is_lab_tested, completeness %
domains_aggregated.4_calendar_tasks_and_urgency: pending, overdue, completed tasks, schedule link, urgency flags, due dates in Asia/Dhaka
domains_aggregated.5_cultivation_activities: chronological farm events, activity types, input materials, costs, notes
domains_aggregated.6_crop_observations_and_diagnoses: farmer visual scouting reports vs AI leaf disease diagnoses strictly separated
domains_aggregated.7_harvest_quantities_and_maunds: total kg, official maunds (40 kg/maund), record count, partial/final tracking
domains_aggregated.8_harvest_date_and_defensible_yield: latest harvest date, defensible yield rate with calculation_status ('exact', 'partial', 'not_available')
domains_aggregated.9_farm_associated_predictions: disease diagnoses and farm-matched crop recommendations, legacy/unbound models explicitly unlinked
